purpose: Confirm seed stability and physics attribution for at most two S10-promoted physics-informed candidates under the same five grouped outer folds.
evidence_label: historically exposed grouped OOF confirmation; not blind, external, or a new FEM panel
numerical_reference: one FEM model implemented and solved in COMSOL
epoch_rule: For each finalist and outer fold, reuse the epoch selected exclusively by the four S10 inner folds. No seed-specific, outer-target, or S11-target epoch selection.
initialization_rule: Refit every seed, fold and variant from a new initialization; never warm-start from S10 or another seed.
data_rule: Reuse the exact S10 FEM/COMSOL authority, causal inputs, active Beam graph, fold-local representations, train/validation trajectory assignments and CAL-only transforms.
prediction_rule: Write exact-once full 68-case OOF displacement and direct velocity fields for every finalist, variant and seed.

comparison_views.incremental: candidate incremental prediction versus the same FEM/COMSOL incremental target
comparison_views.total: target-fold-clean B2 base plus candidate increment versus FEM/COMSOL total field

hard_gates: same case, saved time, observation node and global component
stable in at least four of five seeds
predictive_noninferiority: For X, Y and Z separately, no pooled, P90 or worst total-displacement metric may degrade more than 2% relative to common-split B2 or the capacity-matched control.
material_gain: Apply the frozen portfolio alternatives: >=5% pooled reduction in at least two primary components, or >=10% P90/worst reduction, or predictive noninferiority with robust physical/modal/spectral/graph/computational gain.
physics_attribution: Compare physics and capacity-matched control with paired fold and seed summaries; a mean-only improvement cannot compensate a failed hard, P90, worst-case, stability or leakage gate.
checkpoint_reporting: Report every seed. Use the median-performing admitted seed as the representative checkpoint; never select the most favorable seed.
execution_gate: PASS_S10_PROMOTION_DECISION with one or two promoted candidates and PASS_S10_SCIENTIFIC_DECISION_PIPELINE
